name: Ginger-Teriyaki Dusted Angus Beef Tenderloin
whyItWorks: Center-cut beef tenderloin (filet) has almost zero tough connective tissue, and the ginger-teriyaki crust adds savory umami without chili burn.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium for maximum tenderness at Animator's Palate. Ask to swap the wasabi mashed potatoes and bok choy for plain mashed potatoes or steamed white rice, and hold any coarse black peppercorn crust.
watchOuts: Wasabi in the standard mashed potato side
Overcooking past medium (makes beef fibers tougher)
